answer: A workable design: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The nectar of work and the wharf of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a plume to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
